description_en: Defines the scope of monitoring data to export and returns the Cursor parameter for the initial call to the BatchGet operation
description_zh: 定义导出监控数据的范围并返回用于初始调用BatchGet接口的Cursor参数
kebab_example: aliyun cms-export cursor --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --metric cpu_idle --period 60 --start-time 1641627000000 --end-time 1641645000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Cursor

parameters.help_en:
The namespace of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the namespace of a cloud service, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的数据命名空间。

关于如何获取云产品的数据命名空间，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The metric name of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the metric name of a cloud service, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的监控项名称。

关于如何获取云产品的监控项名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:
The interval of the metric.

Unit: seconds.

The interval of a metric is typically 60 seconds. For special values, see the `Period` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
监控项的时间间隔。

单位：秒。

监控项的时间间隔通常为60秒。特殊取值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html中的参数0
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The start timestamp.

Unit: milliseconds.

Because monitoring data in CloudMonitor is retained for only 90 days, the interval between the start time and the current time must be less than or equal to 90 days
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

由于云监控中的监控数据只能保存90天，建议开始时间与当前时间间隔小于等于90天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end timestamp.

Unit: milliseconds.

The end time has no limit and can be set to a future time
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

结束时间无限制，可以设置为未来的某个时间
parameters.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The key of the metric dimension.

The metric dimension is in the format of key-value pairs, such as `instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****` or `userId:120886317861****`.

For information about how to obtain the dimensions of a metric, see the `Dimension` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
fields.help_zh:
监控项维度的键。

监控项维度的格式：key-value键值对形式的集合，例如：`instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****`或`userId:120886317861****`。

关于如何获取监控项的维度，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html中的参数2
fields.name: label

fields.help_en:
The matching operator of the metric dimension.

Only EQUALS is supported
fields.help_zh:
监控项维度的匹配关系。

目前仅支持EQUALS（等于）
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en:
The value of the metric dimension.

The metric dimension is in the format of key-value pairs, such as `instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****` or `userId:120886317861****`.

For information about how to obtain the dimensions of a metric, see the `Dimension` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
fields.help_zh:
监控项维度的值。

监控项维度的格式：key-value键值对形式的集合，例如：`instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****`或`userId:120886317861****`。

关于如何获取监控项的维度，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html中的参数2
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The dimension information of the metric
parameters.name: matchers

Cursor.description_en: The cursor used for the initial call to the BatchGet operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
